create.name: Robert Peng
create.bio:
Robert Peng is a qigong teacher from Hunan in China. From the age of eight he trained privately with a Buddhist monk named Xiao Yao, learning meditation, energy practice and martial arts drawn from Taoist and Buddhist lines. At fifteen he spent a hundred days fasting and meditating in darkness at a remote mountain monastery, a time he describes as the turning point of his life. He went on to study English at university in Changsha while continuing his training in secret, and began teaching in his late twenties, later working with students in China, Australia, Europe and the United States.

His approach, sometimes called Elixir Light Qigong, is built in stages: foundations, flowing movement, still meditation, and then training for teachers and practitioners. He teaches the three dantians as centres of vitality, love and wisdom, together with Xi breathing, standing meditation, self-massage and the Yi Jin Jing sequence, and presents qigong as a path of virtue as well as energy. Students practise with him in live online classes twice a week, through recorded courses, and at workshops at Omega and elsewhere. He wrote The Master Key and, with Rafael Nasser, The Way of Virtue.

books.title: The Master Key: Qigong Secrets for Vitality, Love, and Wisdom
books.author: Robert Peng
books.description: Peng tells the story of his apprenticeship with the monk Xiao Yao and lays out the practice he learned. He explains the three energy centres and gives step-by-step movements, breathing and meditations for building each of them.

books.title: The Way of Virtue: Qigong Meditations to Cultivate Perfect Peace in an Imperfect World
books.author: Robert Peng, Rafael Nasser
books.description: Written with Rafael Nasser, this book links qigong to the cultivation of virtues such as kindness, patience and integrity. Each chapter pairs a quality of character with a meditation or movement practice to grow it.

courses.title: Qigong Empowerments
courses.description: A five-night residential workshop at Omega's Rhinebeck campus. Peng teaches a sequence of breathing, standing and moving practices for the three dantians, including the hologram palm, the four golden wheels and lotus meditation.

courses.title: Super Qi Weekend
courses.description: A weekend at Omega taught jointly by Robert Peng, Ken Cohen and Michael J. Gelb. The three teachers mix gentle movement, visualisation, breathing and question-and-answer sessions for beginners and experienced practitioners alike.

courses.title: Robert's Daily Energizer
courses.description: A monthly membership with eight live online qigong classes, held on Tuesdays and Thursdays (New York time), and an archive of past sessions. New members get the first month free.

courses.title: Live Long Qigong
courses.description: A seven-week recorded course built on the 312+8 programme, aimed at ageing with strength and grace. It combines point massage, abdominal breathing and simple movements with a community forum.

courses.title: Xi Breathing & 8 Cycles
courses.description: A seven-week recorded course on Xi breathing and the Eight Cycles movement set. It works through the three energy centres and ends with a plan for continuing practice at home.

courses.title: The Way of Virtue Online Course
courses.description: A year-long recorded programme based on his book The Way of Virtue. Monthly themes join a quality of character to qigong meditations and movements, framed as a path of spiritual awakening.
courses.price: $1,698 USD in full, or five payments of $359 USD

courses.title: Yi Jin Jing: The Classic of Changes
courses.description: A fourteen-week recorded course in the Yi Jin Jing, the sinew-changing exercises linked to Bodhidharma and the Shaolin tradition. Each week adds one exercise with its breathing and background.

courses.title: The Master Key Qigong
courses.description: A seventeen-week recorded course that follows the system in his book The Master Key. It covers the foundations of his lineage practice for building vitality, love and wisdom.

courses.title: Guardian Qigong: 4 Cycles to Boost Your Inner Power
courses.description: A short recorded course in the Four Cycles set, joining movement with meditation. It introduces the basics of qi and connecting the central channel with heaven and earth energy.

courses.title: Professional Healer Training: The Inner Transmission of Qigong
courses.description: A thirteen-module certification for students who want to give qigong energy sessions to others, recorded with an option to join a live cohort. It passes on the hands-on and distance methods Peng learned from his teacher.
courses.price: $3,498 USD in full, or $598 USD a month for six months

free_resources.title: Robert Peng Q&A Library
free_resources.description: Recordings of Peng's weekly live question-and-answer sessions on posture, breathing, energy and the ideas behind the practice. Anyone can browse the archive, and the Thursday Zoom session link is posted on the same page.
